title: Saved payment methods across web and mobile
problemStatement: Returning customers re-enter card details on every order. Checkout abandonment for returning customers is 31% against 18% for those with a saved card.
successMeasure: Returning-customer checkout abandonment below 22% within one quarter of launch.

sizing.basis: Initial intake sizing with Product and the tech lead. To be re-sized after the team refines it.

valueEstimate.basis: 1,900 returning-customer abandonments/mo x 31%->22% recovery x $52 AOV, annualised

assumptions: Mobile can reuse the web tokenisation flow
